The '''1982–83 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Dundee United F.C.|Dundee United]], one point ahead of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] and [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. [[Greenock Morton F.C.|Morton]] and [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]] were relegated.

Dundee United clinched the [[list of Scottish football champions|league championship]] with a 2–1 win in a [[Dundee derby]] against [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]] at [[Dens Park]] on the final day of the season.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.scotsman.com/sport/football/spfl-lower-divisions/from-the-archive-dundee-united-clinch-first-league-title-1-2936127 |title=From the archive: Dundee United clinch first league title|first=Mike |last=Aitken |work=The Scotsman |publisher=Johnston Publishing |date=18 May 2013 |access-date=20 December 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/50700041|title=Clocks, bridies & Jim McLean's pyjamas - Dundee Utd's 1983 title win|date=14 May 2023|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=16 May 2023}}</ref>
